entities.summary: Kiran Manral is an Indian author. Based in Mumbai, she published her first novel The Reluctant Detective in 2011. Karmic Kids (2015) her first non-fiction work, is an introduction to parenting based on her own experience of raising a son. Manral is also the founder of India Helps, a network of volunteers that assists disaster victims.
